actions.name: Charm
actions.desc: One humanoid in 30 ft. DC 15 Wis or magically charmed 1 day. Charmed treats succubus as trusted friend and resists harming it. New save if harmed.

actions.name: Draining Kiss
actions.desc: Charmed or willing: 32 (5d10+5) psychic. Max HP reduced by same until long rest. Creature dies if at 0.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.desc: Enters Ethereal Plane from Material Plane or back.

monsters.tactics: Infiltrates as humanoid, charms over days, uses Draining Kiss to drain life force. Etherealness to escape.

monsters.name: Myconid Sovereign
monsters.languages: understands Common but communicates via Rapport Spores

traits.name: Distress Spores
traits.desc: When at 0 HP, releases spores in 240 ft. All myconids aware.

traits.name: Sun Sickness
traits.desc: Disadvantage on attacks, checks, and saves while in sunlight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Two fist attacks.

actions.name: Fist
actions.desc: Melee: +6, reach 5 ft. 8 (1d8+4) bludgeoning + 7 (2d6) poison.

actions.name: Animating Spores (3/Day)
actions.desc: Animates dead humanoid or beast within 5 ft. as zombie under sovereign's control.

actions.name: Hallucination Spores
actions.desc: 30 ft. DC 12 Con or incapacitated 1 minute (hallucinating).

actions.name: Rapport Spores
actions.desc: 30 ft. radius. Creatures sharing spores can communicate telepathically.

monsters.tactics: Hallucinates enemies, animates any fallen as zombies, rallies other myconids.

monsters.name: Ochre Jelly

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: Can move through 1 inch space.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: Climbs ceilings and walls.

traits.name: Split
traits.desc: Subject to lightning or slashing: splits into two smaller jellies if 10+ HP.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee: +4, reach 5 ft. 9 (2d6+2) bludgeoning + 3 (1d6) acid.

monsters.tactics: Drops from ceiling, splits if struck with lightning/slashing, multiplying threat.

monsters.name: Flumph
monsters.languages: understands Undercommon but communicates via telepathy

traits.name: Advanced Telepathy
traits.desc: Can perceive contents of telepathic communication within 60 ft.

traits.name: Prone Deficiency
traits.desc: If prone, can't right itself until flies up.

traits.name: Telepathic Shroud
traits.desc: Immune to divination magic and to effects that would sense its emotions.

actions.name: Tendrils
actions.desc: Melee: +4, reach 5 ft. 4 (1d4+2) piercing + 2 (1d4) acid.

actions.name: Stench Spray (1/Day)
actions.desc: 15 ft. cone. DC 10 Dex or covered in stench for 1d4 hours. Creatures within 5 ft. of stinky target disadvantaged on attacks.

monsters.tactics: Non-violent by nature; uses stench spray defensively. Often an informant for good-aligned PCs.

monsters.name: Troglodyte

traits.name: Chameleon Skin
traits.desc: Advantage on Stealth checks.

traits.name: Stench
traits.desc: Creatures within 5 ft. at start of turn: DC 12 Con or poisoned until start of next turn.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: Disadvantage on attacks and Perception in sunlight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Three attacks: one bite, two claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee: +4, reach 5 ft. 4 (1d4+2) piercing.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee: +4, reach 5 ft. 4 (1d4+2) slashing.

monsters.tactics: Packs overwhelm with stench nauseating and multiattacks. Ambush from stealth.

monsters.name: Doppelganger

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: Can polymorph into Small or Medium humanoid, or back.

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.desc: Advantage on attacks against surprised creatures.

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.desc: Extra 10 (3d6) damage if has advantage on attack and hit.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee: +6, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d6+4) bludgeoning.

actions.name: Read Thoughts
actions.desc: One creature in 60 ft. DC 13 Wis or doppelganger reads surface thoughts for 1 minute. Advantage on Charisma checks against that creature.

monsters.tactics: Takes the form of a trusted NPC, reads thoughts to impersonate perfectly, ambushes when trust established.

monsters.name: Werewolf
damage_immunities: bludgeoning/piercing/slashing from nonmagical weapons not made with silver

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: Can polymorph into wolf-humanoid hybrid, wolf, or back to human.

actions.name: Multiattack (Hybrid Only)
actions.desc: Two attacks: one bite, one claws.

actions.name: Bite (Wolf or Hybrid)
actions.desc: Melee: +4, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d8+2) piercing. DC 12 Con or cursed with lycanthropy.

actions.name: Claws (Hybrid Only)
actions.desc: Melee: +4, reach 5 ft. 7 (2d4+2) slashing.

monsters.tactics: Lurks in human form until night, transforms for ambush. Bite spreads lycanthropy.

monsters.name: Werebear
damage_immunities: bludgeoning/piercing/slashing from nonmagical weapons not made with silver

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: Can polymorph into Large bear-humanoid hybrid, Large brown bear, or back.

actions.name: Multiattack (Human or Hybrid)
actions.desc: Two greataxe attacks (human) or two claw attacks (hybrid).

actions.name: Bite (Bear or Hybrid)
actions.desc: Melee: +7, reach 5 ft. 15 (2d10+4) piercing. DC 14 Con or cursed with lycanthropy.

actions.name: Claw (Bear or Hybrid)
actions.desc: Melee: +7, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8+4) slashing.

actions.name: Greataxe (Human or Hybrid)
actions.desc: Melee: +7, reach 5 ft. 10 (1d12+4) slashing.

monsters.tactics: Protects wilderness. Transforms to bear/hybrid to fight overwhelming threats.
